_comment: Named sets of tests. Run a suite against an environment with:
Keep a suite identical across the environments you intend to compare;
compare_envs.py refuses to compare runs of different suites.
'manual' is yours to edit freely. Because its contents change, the exact
list is recorded in each run's suite.json and compare_envs.py checks the
recorded lists -- not just the suite name -- so two 'manual' runs with
different tests are refused rather than silently half-compared.
